Definition: to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize
BiblicalUsage: 1) to press, drive, oppress, exact, exert demanding pressure; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to press, drive; 1a2) to exact; 1a3) driver, taskmaster, ruler, oppressor, tyrant, lord, exactor of tribute (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be hard pressed
